svg.text: Control at no cost to quality

g.title: msr-vtt videocomposer achieves frechet video distance 580 clip similarity 0.2932 zero-shot
g.desc: On MSR-VTT, VideoComposer achieves a Frechet Video Distance of 580 and a CLIP similarity of 0.2932, zero-shot.

g.title: competitive leading text-to-video systems improves over first-stage pre-training scored 803
g.desc: That is competitive with leading text-to-video systems, and it improves over the model's first-stage pre-training, which scored 803.
g.text: Better than its own text-to-video pre-training
Compositional training does not hurt raw quality (FVD, lower = better)

g.title: adding compositional multi-condition control costs nothing quality videos follow sketches depth motion styles
g.desc: Adding compositional, multi-condition control costs nothing in quality, while videos follow the sketches, depth, motion, and styles users provide.
g.text: Compositional image-to-video: outputs track the supplied controls.
